patch.value: GH-1264: enforce next ready-queue token budgets and disclose omitted recommendations

The SDK computes context packing but returns the complete ranking instead of the packed rows. Explicit token budgets therefore do not bound ready output, and the normal receipt hides the discarded packing decision. Restore binding rendered ready-queue accounting, truthful budget receipts, and SDK/CLI/MCP acceptance.

Explicit budgets bound the documented ready-selection scope; omitted recommendation and rows are disclosed; selection and usage feedback agree with delivered rows; SDK, CLI and MCP preserve the contract; regressions fail before implementation and pass afterward.
